BiblicalUsage: Yeçûwdâh is a foundation, and it stands once, in the psalm of the city of God. His foundation is in the holy mountains, and the LORD loves the gates of Zion more than all the dwellings of Jacob.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God's city stands on holy mountains, and no other foundation will do.
